name: AtomCash
description: One side of a same-chain BCH or CashToken swap. The redeem script is the SolidCash AtomSwap bytecode with its constructor values pushed in front.

seller.name: Seller
seller.description: Locks this side and can refund it after the timeout.

buyer.name: Buyer
buyer.description: Claims this side with the preimage.

tokenCategory.name: Category
tokenCategory.description: CashToken category in consensus byte order. Empty for BCH.

tokenAmount.name: Token amount
tokenAmount.description: Fungible amount the output must pay. Zero for BCH.

fee.name: Fee
fee.description: Satoshis the claim or refund output leaves behind.

secret.name: Preimage
secret.description: 32-byte preimage. Present only on the claim unlock.

scripts.redeem: <fee> <tokenAmount> <tokenCategory> <refundLock> <payoutLock> <secretHash> <timeout> <0x577aa87b88c2529dc0009dc3519dc4519d00cd7b8800d1537a8800d3537a9d00d2008800c65379a06900cc00c6547a949c7777> <0x7105309b> OP_DEFINE <0xb175c2529dc0009dc3519dc4519d00cd537a8800d1537a8800d3537a9d00d2008800c65379a06900cc00c6547a949c7777> <0xbd7b557e> OP_DEFINE OP_DEPTH OP_1SUB OP_ROLL OP_SIZE OP_4 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY OP_INVOKE

offer.name: Swap offer
offer.description: P2SH32 of the AtomSwap redeem script.

claimTransaction.name: Claimed swap
claimTransaction.description: The preimage paid the committed output.

refundTransaction.name: Refunded swap
refundTransaction.description: The timeout paid the committed refund.

claim.name: Claim
claim.description: Pay the committed address with the preimage.

refund.name: Refund
refund.description: Pay the committed refund address after the timeout.
